items.title: What Is Charter Communications (CHTR) Gaining From Its New Local News Alliance?
items.summary: Charter Communications (NasdaqGS:CHTR) and Optimum formed a new alliance to restore and expand local news access across key U.S. markets. The agreement brings back reciprocal carriage of Spectrum News NY1 and News 12 in the New York area. Spectrum News will be introduced in additional regions, including parts of Texas and North Carolina.
